test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is in active voice. Change the voice of the sentence. Select the correct option from the sentences given in options.

Vasant has delivered the speech.

options.text: Vasant delivers the speech on time.
The speech was delivered by Vasant.
The speech was timely delivered by Vasant.
The speech has been delivered by Vasant.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **active voice,** the subject of the sentence (Vasant) performs the action (delivered the speech).
 
• In the **passive voice,** the object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• The action (has delivered the speech) is done by the subject, which is now **"the speech".**
 
• The original subject (Vasant) becomes part of a prepositional phrase (by Vasant) showing who performed the action.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:* 'The speech has been delivered by Vasant.'*
